summary: No reachable vulnerabilities. The header reads only hand.userHoleCards (src/table/review.ts reviewSummary); no opponent hole cards or seat names enter ReviewSummary, so REQ-025 holds. All header values (resultText, position, handNumber, replayCode) are engine-derived and rendered as React text children in ReviewPanel.tsx; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML/innerHTML. Cards go through the existing PlayingCard component. The replay code is shown only once completedHand(table) is non-null (after the hand ends), matching REQ-013.4. No new dependencies, secrets, logging, randomness or file I/O.
